{{MapTabs|Story|Waves = No|Rewards = No}} This page contains the official story elements included in [[Outpost 16]] of the [[Null & Void Event]]. Most of the content is expressed through cutscenes, though some dialogue is important to the storyline. {{RightTOC}} ==Story Overview== This is the first night for the [[Null & Void Event]]. The map appears to have taken place after the regular [[gamemodes]] and previous [[events]]. Before waking up on the 15th of October, [[Scout]] is having yet another nightmare. This time, he is in the middle of a dark forest, he hears weird voices and noises. When he suddenly hears [[Lord Exo]] tells him to touch it, which ends up teleporting the [[Scout]] to the [[Nil Zone]]. There, [[Lord Exo]] threatens to delete him from existence. Exactly at this moment, [[Scout]] wakes up and prepares for the day. [[Scout]] meets up with the research team at [[Outpost 16]], which consists of [[Professor V]] and [[Nerd Duck (Story)|Nerd Duck]], and later other members of the organization. After months of collecting [[God Cube]] fragments, the [[T.D.S. Organization]] has finally collected half of the [[God Cube]] fragments, which some new ones coming from the survival bosses like the [[Brute]] or [[Fallen King]]. They plan on merging them all into one unified partial cube, as this would allow for easier use of them. Not seeing any major issues with the plan, the [[T.D.S. Organization]] begins the merger, overseen by the [[Dispatcher]] and [[Commander]] outside and by [[Professor V]] and [[Nerd Duck (Story)|Nerd Duck]] on the inside, with a few soldier like the [[Scout]] and [[Minigunner]] patrolling the area. The merger begins, causing the shards to combine into a large floating ball. This, however, causes issues for the entire outpost, which has lost control over the [[God Cube]]. While the initial goal was hiding in a bunker, this is stopped by multiple rifts opening. Although unclear what these are, it becomes clear once the [[Nulling]], [[Null Pyromancer]] and [[Null Engineer]] come out that the [[Outpost 16]] is now under attack of the [[Nil Zone]] creatures. This leads to a fight between the [[T.D.S. Organization]] and the [[Nil Zone]] entities, trying to stop them from destroying the outpost while the research team works on a solution. As the fight progresses, it is revealed through dialogue that the [[God Cube]] is only compromised of roughly half the fragments as the others are currently in the possession of the [[Children of Exo]], with [[Professor V]] suggesting it may have been more stable if all the fragments were in one place. Later, the players are told through dialogue that the [[God Cube]] merger is causing all the corrupted energy its been keeping inside of it to get released into the world, which if not prevented or incorrectly stopped could lead to the destabilization or complete destruction of the realm. By the end of the fight, a corrupted recreation of the [[Commander]] called the [[Null Commander]] appears. Around the same time, the [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]] meets up with [[Two X]], who orders the [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]] to deal with the [[God Cube]] being rebuilt. While the [[Null Commander]] is defeated, [[Professor V]] and [[Nerd Duck (Story)|Nerd Duck]] are completely unable to stop the merger, leading to the entire outpost to get evacuated. During this, the [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]] finally appears at the outpost, stabilizing the [[God Cube]] fragments into a unified cube and taking them away from the [[T.D.S. Organization]]. After finding those responsible, the [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]] sentences them to the [[Banlands]] by creating a portal beneath them, then teleports away from the outpost. ==Opening Cutscene== {| class="empty-table align-center" style="width:800px; margin:0 auto" !Cutscene ![[God Cube]] Status Report |- |[[File:Null & Void Event Night 1 All Cutscenes - Tower Defense Simulator|400px|thumb|center]] |[[File:God Cube Status Report - Tower Defenese Simulator - Null & Void|400px|thumb|center]] |} ===Synopsis=== The following summarizes the events shown in the opening cutscene.
'''Synopsis'''
The [[Scout]] is having yet another nightmare, this time one which starts off similarly to [[The Umbra]]'s origin story. After running in the middle of the forest, he trips over and lands next to the [[God Cube]]. Tempted by [[Lord Exo]], he touches it, causing him to get sent to the [[Nil Zone]] where [[Lord Exo]] tries to delete him. Before this can happen, the [[Scout]] wakes up to his clock alarm. The [[Scout]] prepares for work, as today the [[T.D.S. Organization]] plans to merge all the [[God Cube]] fragments they have collected so far into a partial unified cube. First, he meets up with [[Professor V]] and [[Nerd Duck (Story)|Nerd Duck]], then meets the [[Dispatcher]], [[Commander]] and [[Minigunner]] in the command room. There, [[Professor V]] explains the benefits of the merger, which is mainly easier control over the fragments and being able to contain them better. Seeing no issues with the plan, the [[Dispatcher]] allows for it to go through. The [[Dispatcher]], alongside the [[Commander]], [[Minigunner]] and [[Scout]] are sent to overview the merger on the ground, while [[Professor V]] and [[Nerd Duck (Story)|Nerd Duck]] control it from the tower. As the merger begins, the whole facility loses control over the [[God Cube]] fragments, leading to rifts opening to the [[Nil Zone]]. This allows the creatures from it to enter the [[Overworld]].
===Script=== The following is a script-based transcription of the events shown in the opening cutscene.
'''Script'''
[[File:Null&VoidN1Opening.ogg|300px]]
''The [[Scout]] finds himself in a pitch black environment, voices lingering around him as he stumbles forward, revealing what appears to be a dark and desolate desert. He then discovers [[The Umbra]], after which he continues to look around before she suddenly becomes responsive.'' {{Color|LordExo|The Umbra}}: RUN. ''The [[Scout]] starts running through the desert, as it starts to become windy. He then trips over and finds the [[God Cube]] right in front of him. [[Lord Exo]]'s laughter starts becoming audible as he approaches the [[God Cube]].'' {{Color|LordExo|Lord Exo}}: Touch the cube. {{Color|LordExo|Lord Exo}}: My power awaits. ''After this, he leans towards the cube, only for a glitch occurs and knock him away from it. He gets back up to see a large pillar, with [[Lord Exo]] revealing himself from the top of it. [[Lord Exo]] telekinetically lifts the [[Scout]] into the air before a button reading "DELETE" appears next to him, only for [[Lord Exo]] to let him go and send him falling.'' ''The [[Scout]] wakes up in his bed, revealing it to be a nightmare, the alarm clock beside him going off.'' {{Color|Dispatcher|Dispatcher}}: All Operators — Report to R&D headquarters immediately. ''He shuts off the alarm clock, arms and suits himself up as he leaves the room as he sets off for [[Outpost 16]], showing a calendar which is on 15th of October, circled with "MERGE". After getting there, he waits in the elevator as it goes up to the Research Department, where [[Professor V]] and the [[Nerd Duck (Story)|Nerd Duck]] are present.'' {{Color|ProfessorV|Professor V}}: Another bad dream? Its{{sic}} been over a month now. ''[[Professor V]] hands the [[Scout]] a cup of coffee.'' {{Color|NerdDuck|Nerd Duck}}: Jerk. {{Color|ProfessorV|Professor V}}: Today's the big day. {{Color|ProfessorV|Professor V}}: We've been working on this project for months, and now we're finally ready. ''[[Professor V]] opens the door to what seems to be a command center, with the [[Commander]], [[Dispatcher]] and [[Minigunner]] already present in the room.'' {{Color|ProfessorV|Professor V}}: Come on, let's give you the rundown. {{Color|ProfessorV|Professor V}}: The new portal technology allowed us to gather the remaining God Shards {{Color|ProfessorV|Professor V}}: And now we can finally merge them together. ''A monitor opens, showing what appears to be a large platform used for holding the God Shards, with text on-screen detailing about merging them together back into a partial [[God Cube]].'' {{Color|ProfessorV|Professor V}}: It would open a door to infinite possibilities. {{Color|ProfessorV|Professor V}}: We've already accomplished so much in a short amount of time ''The screen then proceeds to show the message "MANY GOD SHARDS RETRIEVED", showing [[Brute|the]] [[Grave Digger|five]] [[Patient Zero|survival]] [[Molten Mode|mode]] [[Fallen King|bosses]] and what appears to be their God Shards.'' {{Color|ProfessorV|Professor V}}: Just imagine what else we could achieve. {{Color|NerdDuck|Nerd Duck}}: Exactly. ''The screen now shows the God Shards merging to form a piece of the [[God Cube]].'' {{Color|ProfessorV|Professor V}}: A single unit is far easier to defend than multiple fragments. {{Color|ProfessorV|Professor V}}: It's a win-win scenario. {{Color|Dispatcher|Dispatcher}}: It looks good on paper {{Color|Dispatcher|Dispatcher}}: But are you absolutely sure this will work? {{Color|NerdDuck|Nerd Duck}}: Yup! {{Color|Commander|Commander}}: Then we'll follow your lead. {{Color|ProfessorV|Professor V}}: Alright, let's begin. ''The [[Dispatcher]] and the T.D.S. Agents descend down the elevator and head outside of the building to see the construct holding the God Shards.'' {{Color|Commander|Commander}}: We're in position. {{Color|Commander|Commander}}: Woah, there's more safety measures than I remember. {{Color|ProfessorV|Professor V}}: Risk-wise, we've mitigated it as much as possible {{Color|ProfessorV|Professor V}}: But it's not zero. {{Color|NerdDuck|Nerd Duck}}: Well, it could still blow up. {{Color|ProfessorV|Professor V}}: Can you not? ''Professor V pulls out [[Children of Exo#Sentinel Ramiel|Sentinel Ramiel]]'s makeshift portal keycard.'' {{Color|ProfessorV|Professor V}}: Thanks for the cheat sheet. ''She inserts the keycard into the terminal.'' {{Color|ProfessorV|Professor V}}: Ready? {{Color|Dispatcher|Dispatcher}}: Ready. ''[[Professor V]] pushes the lever, the God Shards begins to converge as the agents watches the process initiates. A critical error occurs in the control room.'' {{Color|ProfessorV|Professor V}}: Energy levels exceeding set parameters. {{Color|ProfessorV|Professor V}}: ND, initiate the dampening protocol. ''[[Nerd Duck (Story)|Nerd Duck]] presses the button to try and weaken the God Shards, which appears to have no effect.'' {{Color|ProfessorV|Professor V}}: It's not responding, the shards are destabilizing! {{Color|Dispatcher|Dispatcher}}: Shut it down! {{Color|ProfessorV|Professor V}}: We're trying! {{Color|ProfessorV|Professor V}}: The system's overloading! It's not responding to the shutdown protocols! {{Color|Dispatcher|Dispatcher}}: This is an order to shelter in place! {{Color|Dispatcher|Dispatcher}}: Everyone, get to an emergency bunker NOW! ''Portals starts opening all around Outpost 16. A [[Nulling]], a [[Null Pyromancer]] and a [[Null Engineer]] comes out from one of the portals. The [[Null Pyromancer]] roars at the T.D.S. Agents.'' {{Color|Commander|Commander}}: That isn't us! OPEN FIRE! ''The T.D.S. Agents draw their guns out to hold off the incoming enemies coming from the portals, which also starts to destabilize.''

(Official) Tower Defense Simulator Cutscene Soundtrack - NULL AND VOID ==Boss Cutscene== [[File:Null & Void Event Night 1 All Cutscenes - Tower Defense Simulator|750px|thumb|center]] ===Synopsis=== The following summarizes the events shown in the boss cutscene.
'''Synopsis'''
[[Two X]] is seen looking over something while the [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]] arrives to ask him what what he wants them to do. [[Two X]] orders the [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]] to deal with the [[God Cube]] being rebuilt, which could lead to [[Lord Exo]] being freed. The [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]] then leaves to confront the [[T.D.S. Organization]].
===Script=== The following is a script-based transcription of the events shown in the boss cutscene.
'''Script'''
[[File:Null&VoidN1Boss.ogg|300px]]
''[[Two X]] can be seen observing something in his realm, the [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]] comes out from a portal behind him.'' {{Color|Dispatcher|Rift Walker}}: What would you like to do? {{Color|2x2|Two X}}: Protect the Meta, he can't be freed. ''The [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]] turns around to exit his realm to confront the [[T.D.S. Organization]].'' {{Color|2x2|Two X}}: I won't allow it.

(Official) Tower Defense Simulator Cutscene Soundtrack - NULL AND VOID ==Ending Cutscene== [[File:Null & Void Event Night 1 All Cutscenes - Tower Defense Simulator|750px|thumb|center]] ===Synopsis=== The following summarizes the events shown in the ending cutscene.
'''Synopsis'''
[[Professor V]] and [[Nerd Duck (Story)|Nerd Duck]] could not stop the merger, leading to the [[God Cube]] merger being nearly finished. This caused an evacuation of the entire outpost. During this, the [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]] emerges from the portal and stops the [[God Cube]] by grabbing the fragments and combining them, stopping all the chaos in the facility. After the [[Commander]] has realized his presence, the [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]] berates the [[T.D.S. Organization]] for trying to merge it, then sentences them to the [[Banlands]], where all memory of them will be destroyed. After opening a portal under the [[Commander]], [[Dispatcher]], [[Scout]] and [[Minigunner]], he leaves [[Outpost 16]], leaving [[Professor V]] and [[Nerd Duck (Story)|Nerd Duck]] alone in it.
===Script=== The following is a script-based transcription of the events shown in the ending cutscene.
'''Script'''
[[File:Null&VoidN1Ending.ogg|300px]]
''The God Shards are close to finishing their merger, leading to extreme levels of destruction around the outpost..'' {{Color|Titus|Alarm}}: EMERGENCY EVACUATION INITIATED {{Color|Titus|Alarm}}: ALL PERSONEL PROCEED TO DESIGNATED SAFE ZONES. {{Color|ProfessorV|Professor V}}: No, no... {{Color|ProfessorV|Professor V}}: NO NO NO! ''The [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]] appears in person to the T.D.S. Agents. He takes the newly formed partial [[God Cube]] right as it finishes, catching the [[Commander]]'s attention.'' {{Color|Commander|Commander}}: Oh- Wha- WAIT! Who IS that?! {{Color|Dispatcher|Rift Walker}}: The Cube should have remained shattered. {{Color|Dispatcher|Rift Walker}}: It's{{sic}} existence alone is a threat to us all. {{Color|Dispatcher|Rift Walker}}: You cannot fathom the sacrifices we've made. {{Color|Dispatcher|Rift Walker}}: And now that you've threatened the delicate balance of The Meta... {{Color|Dispatcher|Rift Walker}}: We will eradicate your existence SO THOROUGHLY {{Color|Dispatcher|Rift Walker}}: That not even the memory of you will remain. ''The [[Dispatcher]] jumps in front of the agents.'' {{Color|Dispatcher|Dispatcher}}: We weren't trying to! ''The Rift Walker opens a portal on the floor, right in front of the agents to deter them.'' {{Color|Dispatcher|Rift Walker}}: There are no second chances. ''He opens another portal to leave with the God Cube, the scene cuts back to the control room.'' {{Color|NerdDuck|Nerd Duck}}: Oh no... {{Color|ProfessorV|Professor V}}: What.. Have we done? ''The screen turns into black and behind of it a mysterious person voice can be heard'' {{Color|Narrator|???}}: A dreadful night, isn't it?
